scale.meaning: 0 fails the criterion, 2 is acceptable, 4 is exemplary

dimensions.title: Probing efficiency
criteria: Reaches an accurate read of the learner's level in few questions
Each question separates a strand's floor from its ceiling rather than repeating a level
Stops probing once the evidence is enough; does not quiz past it
The assessment names misconceptions the answers actually showed

dimensions.title: Plan quality
criteria: Steps are ordered so every step builds only on earlier ones
Granularity fits the learner: no step is a leap, none is trivial
The plan starts where the probe said to start and aims at the stated goal
A rewrite after feedback addresses that feedback

dimensions.title: Question quality
criteria: The question tests understanding, not recall of the teacher's own wording
Distractors are plausible and tied to real misconceptions
The prompt and options never reveal the answer
The explanation teaches why, in terms the learner can use
